source_index_lines: - [[eac-mofi-sourcepoint-8]] — Erin's Audio Corner Klippel review, 2023-12-20 (Tier A)
brand_notes: MoFi (MoFi Electronics, Chicago) SourcePoint line designed by Andrew Jones: concentric 1.25" soft-dome in paper-cone woofer, 1.6 kHz crossover, 5-year warranty. SP8 (8" coax, 456 mm tall) is in scope; SP10 and SP10 Master Edition (10", 572 mm tall) are out of scope on size. SP8 launch $2,750, now $2,195 pair at retailers. mofi.com product URL returned 404 to scripted fetch. Sources: mfr-mofi-sourcepoint-8, eac-mofi-sourcepoint-8.
takeaways: Erin Klippel: LW ±1.3 dB, f3 52 Hz, smooth DI, 122 deg horizontal beamwidth, pref 5.15 / 7.28 (sub)
Measured sensitivity 85.9 dB vs 87 dB claim; Stereophile estimates ~87 dB
High, easy impedance: min ~8 Ω (EAC) / 7.47 Ω (Stereophile) vs 6.4 Ω claimed; EPDR min 3.8-4.3 Ω
Distortion graph-read ~2.2% at 86 dB and ~6.5% at 96 dB near 100 Hz; compression under ~0.5 dB above 100 Hz at 102 dB
Critics (Stereophile, Future Audiophile) praise balance, imaging, punchy bass; limited below 50 Hz
conflicts: Min impedance 8.0 (EAC) vs 7.47 (Stereophile) vs 6.4 claimed; EPDR 4.3 vs 3.83
